description: Get the most recent invoice. When getting a single invoice, the downloadUrl property is expanded automatically.

operations.description: Gets the most recent invoice. When getting a single invoice, the downloadUrl property is expanded automatically.

consts.description: Version of the API to be used with the client request. The current version is 2017-04-24-preview.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Array of billing period ids that the invoice is attributed to.
props.name: billingPeriodIds

props.description: A secure link to download the PDF version of an invoice. The link will cease to work after its expiry time is reached.
props.name: downloadUrl

props.description: The time in UTC at which this download URL will expire.
props.name: expiryTime

props.description: The URL to the PDF file.
props.name: url

props.description: The end of the date range covered by the invoice.
props.name: invoicePeriodEndDate

props.description: The start of the date range covered by the invoice.
props.name: invoicePeriodStartDate

responses.description: Error response describing why the operation failed.
